pr_title: Fix: unstable sort skips/duplicates issues across pages
pr_body:
When viewing issues in sorted order, some issues are duplicated across pages and some are missing. This is caused by the lack of tie-breakers in database queries, making pagination inconsistent.

Fixes #13395.

issue_context.title: Missing/Duplicate issue when sorting by nearest due date
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.12.5
- Git version: 2.25.1
- Operating system: Ubuntu Server 20.04
- Database (use `[x]`):
  - [x] PostgreSQL
  - [ ] MySQL
  - [ ] MSSQL
  - [ ] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [ ] Yes (provide example URL)
  - [ ] No
  - [x] Haven't tried
- Log gist: N/A

## Description

When sorting by nearest due date, some issues are duplicated and some cannot be found when going through pages. In my case the first page contains issue 108 and 118, and the second page still contains them but in a different order mixed with other issues. The overall issue count remains the same, but since some are duplicated some can't be found. This can be reproduced both at the per user issues page and the repository issues page.

One thing to note is that they all have the same due date and are all past due by less than a day.

## Screenshots

Page 1:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28813824/97832924-e7803080-1c88-11eb-883f-29a620724b7b.png)
Page 2:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28813824/97832946-f49d1f80-1c88-11eb-98e3-b4d08fb7f97e.png)
comments: Reproduced after upgrading to 1.13.0. Random guess: unstable sort.

Reproduced after upgrading to 1.14.3, seems that it doesn't matter to be past due by a day. This sample is past due by a long while but still on the same day.
![page 6](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28813824/124995932-f465d880-dffc-11eb-9aa4-a86c4866e0f4.png)
![page 7](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28813824/124995934-f4fe6f00-dffc-11eb-8c0c-3dd67c7e63ce.png)
Probably need to add ID as second sort parameter

Just encountered a duplicate issue that is not past due. So it seems that the only requirement is that they must be due on the same day, so my best guess is temporally inconsistent sorting across pages.

review_comments: The rationale here is that when sorting by deadline the order of creation do not matter, so in both cases fallback to default, i.e. descending order, i.e. newest first.
See the other one, default would be `.Desc("issue.created_unix").Desc("issue.id")`
